_about: Care facts used by matching and welfare rules. Minimum cage sizes are SAMPLE values (width x depth x height, cm) pending founder confirmation; birds need more horizontal flying length than height. space_needed, daily_minutes, kid_friendly, hands_on and watch_outs are SAMPLE guidance for matching, pending founder review.

species.name: Budgerigar (budgie)
watch_outs: Kept in pairs or more; a single budgie gets lonely.
Can be hand-tamed if bought young.

species.name: Peach-faced lovebird
watch_outs: Loud contact calls, especially morning and evening.
Can nip; better for older children.

species.name: Fischer's lovebird
watch_outs: Loud contact calls.
CITES-listed: the seller must have a PARIVESH registration.

species.name: Cockatiel
watch_outs: Needs daily time out of the cage.
Lives 15 to 20 years: a long commitment.

species.name: Zebra finch
watch_outs: Birds to watch, not to handle.
Keep in pairs or small groups.

species.name: Society (Bengalese) finch
watch_outs: Birds to watch, not to handle.
Very calm and social.

species.name: Canary
watch_outs: Males sing; birds to watch, not to handle.
Sensitive to draughts and fumes.

species.name: Labrador Retriever
watch_outs: Needs at least 1 to 2 hours of exercise daily.
Grows to 25 to 35 kg; needs space.

species.name: Beagle
watch_outs: Loud baying; may disturb neighbours in flats.
Strong scent drive; needs a leash outdoors.

species.name: Shih Tzu
watch_outs: Daily coat brushing and regular grooming.
Sensitive to heat; keep cool in summer.

species.name: Persian cat
watch_outs: Daily brushing to prevent mats.
Flat face: sensitive to heat; keep indoors and cool.
